title.zh: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
title.en: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents

current_state.zh: AI security firm Norforge attributed a campaign that compromised more than 100 websites — including those of John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins — to an army of largely self-directed AI agents, underscoring growing concerns about AI-powered cyberattacks.
